title: WHY CRYPTO LIQUIDITY POOLS ARE PYRAMID SCHEMES! UNDERSTAND THIS BEFORE IT HAPPENS TO YOU!
description:
www.controltoken.net

Crypto Currency Liquidity Pools by design create a structure that sets up the project for failure where only the people at the top win. Once you understand this then you can see crypto defi more clearly and protect yourself from many of the scams going on in crypto.
